title: The Little Cloud Who Learned to Shine
moral: You don’t have to be the biggest or loudest to be special.

scenes.summary: Puff, a very small cloud, feels unimportant compared to other clouds.
scenes.text: High above the green hills and sparkling rivers, in a wide blue sky, lived a little cloud named Puff. Puff was small. Very small. All the other clouds were big, fluffy, and important-looking. They floated across the sky in grand shapes—some looked like castles, others like dragons, and some even like giant elephants. But Puff? “Well… I look like a squished cotton ball,” he sighed. Every morning, the clouds would gather and talk about their jobs. “I brought rain to the farms today!” said a tall gray cloud proudly. “I made a beautiful sunset yesterday!” said a pink and orange cloud. “I thundered so loudly, everyone heard me!” boomed a big storm cloud. Puff stayed quiet. “I don’t do anything special,” he whispered to himself.
scenes.image_prompt: small shy cloud among big colorful clouds shaped like animals and castles in bright blue sky, cartoon style

scenes.summary: A strong wind blows Puff away to a dry village where help is needed.
scenes.text: One day, a strong wind came rushing through the sky. “Whooooosh!” it howled. The big clouds held their places, but Puff was too small. “Oh no!” he cried as the wind pushed him far, far away. He drifted alone until he reached a quiet part of the sky where no other clouds lived. Below him was a small village. Puff looked down and saw something unusual. The ground was dry. The rivers were thin. The trees looked tired. “Oh dear,” said Puff. “They look like they need help.”
scenes.image_prompt: tiny cloud blown by strong wind over dry village with cracked ground and tired trees, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Puff tries to make rain but fails and feels even more discouraged.
scenes.text: Puff remembered what the big gray cloud had said. “I brought rain to the farms today!” “I can try that!” Puff said bravely. He squeezed himself tight. “Come on, rain!” he said. Nothing happened. He squeezed harder. Still nothing. “Oh no,” Puff sighed. “I really can’t do anything.” He began to drift away, feeling sadder than ever.
scenes.image_prompt: small cloud trying hard to rain but nothing happens, looking sad in sky, children’s book cartoon style

scenes.summary: The Sun encourages Puff and together they create a beautiful rainbow.
scenes.text: Just then, a warm voice called out, “Hello there, little cloud!” Puff looked up. It was the Sun, shining brightly. “Why do you look so sad?” the Sun asked. “I’m too small,” Puff said. “I can’t make rain or thunder or anything important.” The Sun smiled gently. “Not all clouds are the same, Puff. You don’t have to be big to be special.” “But what can I do?” Puff asked. “Stay with me for a while,” said the Sun. “Let’s see.” Puff floated slowly in front of the Sun. Suddenly, something amazing happened. A beautiful rainbow stretched across the sky. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet sparkled brightly. “Wow!” Puff gasped. Below, the children in the village looked up and cheered. “Look! A rainbow!” “It’s so pretty!” Puff couldn’t believe it. “Did I… do that?” he asked. “Yes,” said the Sun. “With just a little light and a little cloud, you made something magical.”
scenes.image_prompt: bright sun shining through small cloud creating colorful rainbow over happy village children, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Puff discovers his purpose and happily makes rainbows with the Sun.
scenes.text: Puff felt warm and happy inside. “I don’t need to be big,” he said. “I can make people smile!” From that day on, Puff traveled across the sky, helping the Sun create beautiful rainbows. And whenever children looked up and smiled, Puff smiled too. Even the smallest cloud can do something wonderful. You don’t have to be the biggest or the loudest to be special. Sometimes, all it takes is being yourself.
